lead.title: US FCC bans Chinese humanoid and quadruped robots, citing backdoors in Unitree hardware
lead.summary: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission added Chinese humanoid and quadruped robots to its national security Covered List, barring imports of new units. The ban extends to connected power inverters and targets vulnerabilities already identified in Unitree hardware deployed at MIT, Princeton, and Carnegie Mellon universities.

top_stories.title: Anthropic's Claude autonomously discovers cryptographic weaknesses in HAWK and AES
top_stories.summary: Claude Mythos Preview found a new attack on HAWK (quantum-resistant signature scheme) halving its key strength in ~60 hours, and a 200-800x speedup on reduced-round AES attack in a week, at ~$100k compute cost per result. Anthropic released technical papers and the CryptanalysisBench benchmark.

top_stories.title: xAI launches Build Mode and Grok 4.5 in GitHub Copilot
top_stories.summary: xAI introduced Build Mode, letting users build and customize AI agents directly within the Grok platform, and integrated Grok 4.5 into GitHub Copilot for AI-powered code completions in the IDE.

top_stories.title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
top_stories.summary: Cyera, which raised $600M at a $12B valuation, acquired Oasis Security for $1B to expand AI security capabilities as agent deployments surge across enterprises.

top_stories.title: Perplexity launches Personal Computer for Windows — an AI desktop agent
top_stories.summary: Perplexity turned local Windows PCs into AI-powered digital workers that read files, automate apps, and route tasks across 20+ frontier models, competing directly with agentic desktop tools.

items.title: IMACS: Decoupling organization, coordination, and collaboration in multi-agent LLM systems
items.summary: Multi-agent frameworks routinely entangle three logically distinct concerns: who is on the team, how members align, and which algorithm fuses their work. IMACS introduces a decoupled taxonomy evaluated across 10 benchmark environments.

items.title: Retraction-free optimization over the Stiefel manifold for LoRA fine-tuning
items.summary: A retraction-free optimizer avoids costly orthonormalization during LoRA fine-tuning, achieving 2-3x speedup over standard methods while maintaining convergence quality on LLM tasks.

items.title: CLBench-V: Evaluating multimodal context learning from grounding to knowledge acquisition
items.summary: A multimodal benchmark reveals that even top MLLMs fail at basic grounding tasks (color, shape, counting) while excelling at knowledge transfer — exposing a gap in atomic visual perception.

items.title: Shieldstral: A 3B-parameter multimodal safety classifier matching models 7x its size
items.summary: A policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier that matches or outperforms models nearly 7x its size on text safety benchmarks and sets a new SOTA on multimodal safety classification.

items.title: Raven: High-recall sequence modeling with sparse memory routing at 32K tokens
items.summary: A linear-time sequence model with sparse memory routing that achieves near-perfect recall on long-range dependency tasks up to 32K tokens, outperforming SSMs and linear Transformers on the Long Range Arena.

items.title: Kimi K3 draws attention for agentic and long-running capabilities; Moonshot AI architect to present July 30
items.summary: Kimi K3 is getting significant attention for its agentic and long-running capabilities. Together AI published a comprehensive usage guide and is hosting an event on July 30 with Moonshot's Feihu Tang for a deep dive on architecture and production inference.

items.title: Papers explore distilling proprietary models to open-source via multi-agent protocol distillation
items.summary: Recent papers discuss distilling from proprietary to open-source models via multi-agent protocol distillation for agentic search, and stateful approaches for long-horizon computer-use agents.

items.title: Together AI announces production inference improvements for open-weights deployments
items.summary: Together AI posted about production inference improvements including capacity-aware routing, rollouts, and autoscaling on dedicated endpoints that benefit open-weights deployments.

items.title: US FCC bans Chinese humanoid and quadruped robots, citing national security risks
items.summary: The FCC added Chinese humanoid and quadruped robots to its Covered List, barring imports of new units. The ban extends to connected power inverters and targets vulnerabilities in Unitree hardware deployed at MIT, Princeton, and Carnegie Mellon.

items.title: AMD secures up to 2.5 GW of AI data center capacity from Core Scientific
items.summary: AMD signed a deal with Core Scientific to secure up to 2.5 GW of data center capacity across five sites, optimized for AMD Instinct GPUs, EPYC CPUs, and ROCm software.

items.title: Tesla Optimus humanoid and robotaxi business disappoints investors amid production delays
items.summary: Tesla's recent earnings revealed major disappointments in its humanoid Optimus business and robotaxi program, with production timelines slipping and investor confidence wavering.

items.title: Prefactor — real-time AI agent evaluation and enforcement platform launches as #1 Product Hunt
items.summary: Prefactor offers real-time evaluation of AI agents in production, scoring every run for quality, drift, and risk, then enforcing policies automatically or with human approval.

items.title: Cekura — automated QA for voice AI and chat AI agents
items.summary: Cekura provides a testing, observability, and self-improvement platform for production voice and chat AI agents, simulating thousands of scenarios to catch regressions before users do.

items.title: Leaping AI — AI voice agents for calls and text campaigns
items.summary: Leaping AI, a YC-backed startup, deploys human-like AI voice agents for customer service, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling across calls and SMS.

items.title: BrowserAct: open-source browser automation CLI built for AI agents
items.summary: BrowserAct enables AI agents to browse websites, click buttons, fill forms, solve CAPTCHAs, and extract data via a simple CLI.

items.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
items.summary: Fish Audio raised a $52M seed round led by Coreline Ventures and Capital Today for AI voice models targeting creators and enterprise use cases.

items.title: AI startup Dwelly raises $170M for real estate rollup
items.summary: Dwelly raised a $170M Series B ($95M equity) led by EQT Growth and General Catalyst for AI-powered real estate and proptech operations.

items.title: Hush Security raises $30M to close the AI agent governance gap
items.summary: Hush Security raised a $30M Series A for AI agent governance and security, with Akamai Technologies joining as a strategic investor.

items.title: Codeberg members vote to ban projects consisting mostly of AI-written code
items.summary: Codeberg's members voted 358 to 144 to amend their Terms of Use, prohibiting projects that consist primarily of AI-generated code, weeks after prominent developer Theo (t3.gg) urged the community to move to the platform.

items.title: Higgsfield offers 24-hour free unlimited access to Seedance 2.0 AI video models
items.summary: Higgsfield is running a promotion giving new users 24 hours of free unlimited access to its top image, video, and audio models including Seedance 2.0, running July 28-31.
